name: tarvent
label: Tarvent
description: Tarvent is an email marketing, automation, and email API platform that allows to you to send campaigns, manage contacts, automate your marketing, and more.

tagAction.label: Replace existing tags
tagAction.description: Add only adds the tags the contact does not already have. Replace replaces all contact tags with the entered tags.

tagIds.label: Tags
tagIds.description: Tags to add to the contact, as a list of tag names.

audienceDataFields.description: An object of audience data field IDs to values. GDPR fields take 1 or 0.
